characters.name: John Constantine
characters.description: The Protagonistand an accomplished exorcist. He learns that he has a fatal case of lung cancer and is finally going to Hell. Eventually, he meets and agrees to help Detective Angela Dodson. Adaptational Attractiveness: While comic John certainly has a rough charm and no problem attracting partners (he was originally based onSting), he is nowhere near as pretty as Keanu Reeves. Adaptational Badass: He's just as much of a badass in the original comics, but here, he is a noticeably better fighter than the poor one that the John Constantine of theHellblazercomics is established to be. Adaptational Nationality: He's changed from British to American. Adaptation Dye-Job: Here played by the dark-hairedKeanu Reeves, but a blond in the comics.

characters.name: Angela Dodson
characters.description: Agent Scully: Is as first skeptical about the supernatural in general, and even suppresses her own talent. But after her time with Constantine she comes around. Always Identical Twins: With her sister Isabel. Angsty Surviving Twin: Angela feels guilty that she wasn't there for Isabel and didn't support her. This guilt helps drive her to find out what Isabel had been going through when she died. Audience Surrogate: Her role in the story.Played Withsomewhat when John drops an infodump on her about theSpear of Destiny. As she's Catholic, she's a bit annoyed that she's being lectured about the Crucifixion. Catapult Nightmare: She wakes up in panic, after a nightmare of her sister killing herself. Unfortunately, it is more than just a mere nightmare.

characters.name: Isabel Dodson
characters.description: Always Identical Twins: With Angela. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: She looks very good for someone who jumped off a 20-foot building and crashed through a glass roof into a swimming pool. Aside from being dead, of course. Claimed by the Supernatural: When Constantine meets her soul in Hell, she has a mark on her wrist that looks like a cross inside a circle. When Father Hennessy touches her dead body, the mark appears on her wrist. Constantine later discovers that the mark is the symbol of theBig BadMammon and that Mammon was trying topossess herin order to carry out his evil plan. Demonic Possession: To make her commit suicide. Driven to Suicide: Her suicide, caused by Mammon, is what starts the film's plot.

characters.name: Gabriel
characters.description: Adaptational Badass: Is powerful enough thatContantine has to make a deal with Lucifer to stop him. Adaptational Villainy:Gabriel inHellblazerwas still aHolier than ThouJerkasssnob, but wasn't trying to unleash Hell on Earth. Angelic Transformation: In the climax,he is de-winged as punishment for plotting to unleash Mammon upon the world, leaving a pair of bloody stumps. Constantine introduces him to pain with a punch to the mouth. Archangel Gabriel: Not stated, but going off of the name andArchangel Lucifer's recognition of them. Big Bad Duumvirate:With Mammon.Gabriel is helping tobring him into the world and create hell on Earth, enlisting the help of Balthazar to carry out the dirty work.

characters.name: Balthazar
characters.description: Badass Boast: "Fire? I was born from this!" Big "NO!": Alas, poor himwhen he is vaporized by Gabriel. Coin Walk Flexing: In his first and quite a few of his later scenes, Balthazar ends up walking an old coin across his fingers.It's because of this tic that Angela finds out, for sure, that he killed a friend of Constantine's. Cool and Unusual Punishment: Constantine interrogates and gets him to talk by reading him his last rites, threatening him with the punishment of being forgiven for his sins and being sent to Heaven instead of Hell when he dies. Balthazar protests that John doesn't have the power to do this, he's not a priest, but John keeps going and it finally scares him enough to spill the beans.Afterward John informs him that you have toaskfor absolution for it to count, and he was probably right on the priest point anyway. Demon Lords and Archdevils: Is a half-breed demon.

characters.name: Mammon
characters.description: Ambition Is Evil: He plots to turn the mortal plane into his own personal kingdom. Big Bad Duumvirate: Plots alongsideGabrielto unleash himself on Earth. Demon Lords and Archdevils: Mammon is a Prince of Hell and Balthazar's boss. Enemy Rising Behind: He rises behind Constantinewhen he possesses Angela. Fetus Terrible: What an adorable little cosmic horrorAngela is bearing.

characters.name: Lucifer
characters.description: Actually Pretty Funny: Satan is quite amused by the classical terms that Gabriel hurls at him."I do miss the old names." All There in the Manual: The novelization not only reveals that his full name is "Lucifer Rofocale", but that he is alsoThe First of the Fallen, distinguishing him from the more notableLucifer Morningstar. Arch-Enemy: God by default, with Constantine as a strong second. Bad Guys Do the Dirty Work:He ends up saving the day when he stops Gabriel from summoning Mammon to Earth. It's downplayed in that what he does isn't so much villainous as the fact that no one else could do it. Character Tic: He sniffles frequently.It is much creepier than it sounds; think less "sick with a cold" and more "starving animal that smells fresh meat".

characters.name: Chas Kramer
characters.description: Adaptational Attractiveness: In the comic and the Tv series Chas is not bad looking but he's a grizzled, older man. Here he isShia LaBeoufat his most fresh faced and cute. All Up to You: He briefly takes a surprisingly heroic action, only to then be killed while he is monologing. The Driver: He drives a cab and tranports Constantine. He's Dead, Jim: He is slammed up against the ceiling and down to the floor a few times, leaving him severely injured. He talks with John Constantine for a few seconds, then stops and lies with his eyes open. John turns away and leaves him for dead without even checking his pulse. Killed Mid-Sentence:Subverted. He is mortally wounded while saying the following, but he survives long enough to give John meaningful last words.Chas:This is Kramer. Chas Kramer, assho...

characters.name: Father Hennesey
characters.description: The Alcoholic: He drinks constantly to keep the voices of the deads talking to him at bay. It is implied he went to AA before, but stopped to do so because he couldn't sleep because of the voices.Balthazar gladly takes advantage of this to murder him by forcing him to drink alcohol to death.Constantine:Going to a lot of meetings, I see.Father Henessey:It keeps the voices out, so I can sleep. I have to sleep, John. Death by Irony:Hennessy, who drank to dull his psychic powers, dies from drinking himself to death in less than a minute. Meaningful Name: Hennessy for the priest who drinks and for theforeshadowthe way he dies. Protective Charm: He has onebut removes it , so he can usehis abilities during the investigation. Later, when it is given to Angela, she inadvertently removed it. Psychic-Assisted Suicide:After reading Isabel's corpse, Hennessey goes for his flask only for it to not pour. He then rushes to the nearest liquor and starts desperately grabbing bottles off the shelf, but none would pour for him when he tried to drink them, even though they clearly contained liquid. After about a minute of this with Balthazar watching on, he collapses and dies. When reviewing the scene afterwards, it's found that he died of acute alcohol poisoning—the bottleswerepouring, but due to Balthazar's illusion, he could not perceive this and drank himself to death. But not before giving John one last message, tipping him off to the plot to bing Mammon to earth.

characters.name: Papa Midnite
characters.description: Adaptational Heroism: To the point of almost beingIn Name Only. The Papa Midnite of the comics was a magician who used his abilities to become the head of a criminal empire for himself, enjoying the pain and suffering of his victims, and tormented Constantine for an entire arc to settle a petty grudge, thoughDepending on the Writerhe wasn't beyond forming anEnemy Minewith him. This version of Papa Midnite is a mage who used his powers to fight the forces of Hell before opening a club for neutral meetings between angels and demons, and eventually breaks off his neutrality to help Constantine at the end of the movie. Good Smoking, Evil Smoking: He subverts the cigarillo trope by being a good/neutral witch doctor turned bartender. Mind Over Matter: Displayed when Papa Midnite flings John into a wall with a simple hand gesture. Retired Badass: Papa Midnite, a mage so powerful that he took on 30 demons by himself. Doesn't need special tools as he has actual magical powers. And powerful enough to create his own embassy of neutrality where hybrids mix and behave under his watch. Team Switzerland: Has built his club long lines of strict neutrality, favoring neither Heaven or Hell. And he means it. Unfortunately, it takes multiple deaths and the looming apocalypse for John to remind him thathisneutrality won't mean anything wheneveryone elseis busy fighting a war that won't stop at his front door.

characters.name: Beeman
characters.description: Death by Irony:Beeman, a guy who collected insects, is killed by them coming out of his body Meaningful Name: His name isBeeman, and he mentions to John that he likes bugs. Sidekick: He is one of the three sidekicks of Constantine and the first one to die. Where Does He Get All Those Wonderful Toys?: He manages to acquire certain rare objects for Constantine...for a price.Beeman: Yeah, easy there, hero. That's Dragon's Breath.John Constantine: I thought you couldn't get it anymore.Beeman: Yeah, well, I, uh, I know a guy who knows a guy.
